title: Manifest — blyg.json
description: §6.1. The fixed-filename discovery anchor (decisions #14, #16). The spec lists no required members explicitly; blyg/feed/items are required here because §4 fixes the paths they name and §12 resolution reads them.

blyg.description: §3.1: the protocol version key, informative (decision #18d); the URI namespace never tracks it (decision #22).

level.description: §3.2: claimed conformance level; informative, readers MUST NOT gate on it.

generator_url.description: §6.1 (decision #34): OPTIONAL, one absolute URL; publishers SHOULD emit it.

site.description: §6.1: self-asserted, display-advisory; never establishes identity (§12.2, decision #17).

feed.description: §6.1/§4: path of the feed; protocol-fixed `feed.xml` at 0.3 (authoritative from 0.4, decision #51).

items.description: §6.1/§4: path of the archive index; protocol-fixed `items/index.json` at 0.3.

blogroll.description: §6.1/§11: OPTIONAL origin-relative path, present only when a non-empty blogroll is served (decision #13).

webmention.description: §6.1/§15.1 (decision #28): OPTIONAL endpoint URL, origin-relative allowed; omitted by static exports.
